name: Nhan Tower
kicker: The brick tower on the river hill
summary: Climb Núi Nhạn for the brick tower on the north bank of the Đà Rằng. The bureau prints nearly 23,5 m, four storeys, and a foot 10 m on each side. The heritage page prints a base of 12,2 m by 12,2 m and a base and body of 12,4 m. The hill is about 60 m on two pages and 64 m on the English page. Both measurements stay. No ticket was printed. Check on arrival.
timeNeeded: A morning, or Saturday evening for the show.
getThere: On the north bank, about 1,5 km from cửa Đà Diễn.
heroCaption: The brick tower on the hill above the Đà Rằng

notice.title: Do not quote one height
notice.body: The bureau prints nearly 23,5 m for the tower. The heritage page prints a base of 12,2 m by 12,2 m and a base and body together of 12,4 m. The hill is about 60 m on the heritage page and the handbook, and 64 m on the English page. Both the tower pair and the hill pair stay. No ticket was printed.

body: The tower is brick, on Núi Nhạn, on the north bank of the Đà Rằng near QL1A. The heritage page puts it in phường I, south side on Bạch Đằng and sông Chùa, about 1,5 km from cửa Đà Diễn. The English page says ward 1. The bureau dates the building to the late 11th or early 12th century: four storeys, nearly 23,5 m, each side of the foot 10 m, a door to the east, and a lotus-bud stone at the top. The heritage page describes a base of 12,2 m by 12,2 m, a body of about 9 m by 9 m, and the base and body together 12,4 m, in a yard of 38 m by 38 m. The nearly 23,5 m and the 12,4 m are different measurements. Both stay.

The hill is about 60 m on the heritage page and the handbook, and 64 m on the English page. Both stay. The bureau says there is no statue, and a small shrine to bà Thượng Đỉnh Chúa Thiết A Na Diễn Ngọc Phi. The heritage page says the worship is Poh Nagar, the east door had collapsed, and the present door is 2,4 m high. Ranked a national architectural relic on 16 November 1988. Ranked a special national relic by Quyết định 1820/QĐ-TTg on 24 December 2018.

Go in the morning for the brick. On Saturday the English page schedules a show at 19:30 in the yard, named “Phu Yen – the attractive and friendly destination.” It does not print that show on other nights. The length was not printed. No ticket was printed on the bureau page, the heritage page, or the English page. Minutes from Độc Lập were not printed. Check on arrival.

gettingThere: The tower is in town, on the river. The heritage page prints about 1,5 km from cửa Đà Diễn. Minutes from Độc Lập were not printed. From the airport, the AIP prints 5 km north of the city center and the handbook prints about 10 km. A taxi fare was not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From the center
legs.body: The hill is on the north bank of the Đà Rằng. The heritage page prints about 1,5 km from cửa Đà Diễn. The minutes were not printed. Check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Độc Lập
legs.body: Minutes from the beach road to the hill were not printed. Check on arrival. The beach-road square at Nguyễn Hữu Thọ and Độc Lập is Nghinh Phong, not this tower.

closed: No weekly closing day is printed.
admissionNote: The bureau, the heritage page, and the English tourism page print no ticket. The Saturday show is 19:30. Its length was not printed. No child rule was printed. Check on arrival.
